RADAR tracks new https://t.co/DVKX2i8Gnz launches, bonding curves, market caps and trading activity in real time

SCANNER analyzes the top 20 holders and first 20 buyers, tracking wallet histories, entries and token distribution

Risk Scoring Model

The system evaluates hidden ownership, fresh wallets, transferred supply, early snipers and holder concentration

Price Impact Model

Impact = 1 − (R / (R + q))²

R = token reserves in the liquidity pool
q = tokens sold by connected wallets

The model estimates how much the price could fall if a linked group exits its positions

RADAR identifies potential runners. SCANNER reveals who’s actually behind them

One system. Real-time alerts. On-chain risk analysis.

items.title: GPT-6 Astra really spent $40 and 11 minutes building a submarine that looks like a radioactive cucumber with fins 😭
items.summary:
GPT-6 Astra really spent $40 and 11 minutes building a submarine that looks like a radioactive cucumber with fins 😭

Meanwhile Claude Code spent $102 creating an entire underwater scene with a detailed submarine, coral reefs and tropical fish

Same prompt, 4 AI workflows

The underwater disaster report 💀

🥇 Blender MCP → $67 / 20 min
🥈 GPT-6 Astra → $40 / 11 min
🥉 Kimi K3.1 → $12 / 3 min
💀 Claude Code → $102 / 28 min

Here's where it gets embarrassing

Kimi was 3.3x cheaper and 3.7x faster than Astra, yet somehow managed to build a more recognizable submarine

But Blender MCP actually delivered the most cinematic underwater environment, with detailed coral, lighting and marine life

The funniest part is that Claude Code made a beautiful scene for $102 while Astra apparently spent $40 inventing an underwater vegetable 😭

items.title: Weekend hack: HackerTube. I was annoyed with YouTube's recommendations so I had Claude filter down 43M comments over 20
items.summary:
Weekend hack: HackerTube. I was annoyed with YouTube's recommendations so I had Claude filter down 43M comments over 20 years of HN to 6,454 videos that keep being recommended. *Significantly* better viewing experience, ~2 hours with Opus 5.5:
https://t.co/JIhXN7OSh1

- Excellent recs without any logins (state is kept in local browser session)
- Thumbnail is a representative frame from middle of the video instead of the super duper A/B test hyper-optimized user uploads
- Underlying data from the comment analysis as one zip file, point your Claude at it and ask for your own version
- HackerTube Longs ✊

A bit more on the process:
I use Claude Code (desktop app for Mac), Opus 5.5 on Medium effort as my default. I only talk to Claude and have it do everything, the only "manual work" I helped with in tandem was in the browser (reminiscent of MenuGen): 1) I had to create some kind of API key from Google Cloud UI to query YouTube for video metadata, 2) I booted up a VPS box for serving and 3) I bought the domain name. Once the box was up I gave Claude the IP and told it update, secure, harden, deploy and optimize the code, and it did the whole thing.

Many awesome projects that would have normally taken weeks/months even can now be few-shotted for breakfast. What else are we not thinking of.
